data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 72306fe2a57fd7db4a6d85698d83976b3719b381
* **Tool:** claude-safe (worktree create + auto-cleanup on Claude exit)
* **Platform:** darwin (macOS)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per CLAUDE.md \"Worktree lifecycle (claude-safe)\": after Claude exits, \`_offer_worktree_cleanup\` auto-removes the worktree if (1) branch is ancestor of main (\`is_merged\`), AND (2) \`git status --porcelain\` is empty (\`is_clean\`). A worktree freshly created from main, in which the user opened Claude and immediately ran \`/quit\` without any edits or commits, must satisfy both conditions and be auto-removed.

#### Actual Behavior

Auto-removal was refused with the message:

\`\`\`
Worktree 'worktree-20260502-114137' cannot be auto-removed:

  Branch 'worktree-20260502-114137' has unmerged commits:
    72306fe2a5 Potential fix for pull request finding
    f2293810ff fix(jira-dig-1575,jira-dig-1576): jira bridge sync chronic defects

Run 'worktree-cleanup.sh' from the main repo to manage worktrees.
\`\`\`

Both flagged commits (72306fe2a5, f2293810ff) are the current HEAD-side commits that the worktree was created from — they are already on \`main\` (the worktree was created immediately after \`Pulling latest from origin. done\`). The \`is_merged\` ancestor check appears to compare against a stale local \`main\` ref (or against \`origin/main\` without fetching/pulling \`main\` itself in the main repo before the comparison), so commits that exist on remote main but not on the local main pointer are misclassified as unmerged.

### 3. Action History

1. \`claude-safe\` invoked from \`/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra\`.
2. Tool printed \`Pulling latest from origin. done\` then \`Creating worktree... done\`.
3. Claude session launched in \`/Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260502-114137\`.
4. User typed \`/quit\` immediately — no tool calls, no edits, no commits, no staged changes.
5. On Claude exit, claude-safe printed the \"cannot be auto-removed\" block above.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

The worktree branch \`worktree-20260502-114137\` was created from \`main\` and never advanced. \`git status --porcelain\` would have been empty (\`is_clean=true\`). The only failing condition is \`is_merged\`. Since the branch HEAD == main HEAD (no new commits), \`git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> main\` should succeed — unless the comparison target is a stale local \`main\` that does not yet contain commits 72306fe2a5 / f2293810ff that \`Pulling latest from origin\` brought into \`origin/main\`. The pull updates \`origin/main\` (and likely the worktree's starting point) but may not fast-forward the main repo's local \`main\` branch when the user is checked out on a different branch in the main repo. Result: \`origin/main\` has the commits, the new worktree branch has the commits, but the local \`main\` ref used for the ancestor check does not — so the ancestor check fails and lists those commits as \"unmerged\".

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* \`claude-safe\` wrapper, specifically the \`_offer_worktree_cleanup\` path.
* CLAUDE.md \"Worktree lifecycle (claude-safe)\" contract.

### 6. Logs

\`\`\`
joeoakhart@Joes-MacBook-Pro digital-service-orchestra % claude-safe
Creating worktree: worktree-20260502-114137 (in /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees)

Note: You have 7 worktrees. Run 'worktree-cleanup.sh' to remove merged ones.

  Pulling latest from origin. done
  Creating worktree... done
  No post-create hook configured — skipping environment setup.

Launching Claude in: /Users/joeoakhart/digital-service-orchestra-worktrees/worktree-20260502-114137

[Claude session opened, user typed /quit immediately, no actions taken]

Worktree 'worktree-20260502-114137' cannot be auto-removed:

  Branch 'worktree-20260502-114137' has unmerged commits:
    72306fe2a5 Potential fix for pull request finding
    f2293810ff fix(jira-dig-1575,jira-dig-1576): jira bridge sync chronic defects

Run 'worktree-cleanup.sh' from the main repo to manage worktrees.
\`\`\`
data.title: [claude-safe worktree-cleanup]: brand-new worktree from main with no session changes -> auto-removal blocked on 'unmerged commits' that are already on main
